    Universal covers of polarized right translation quivers #

    Following Bongartz--Gabriel, the universal-cover vertices are homotopy classes of walks from a fixed base vertex. The walk quiver augments the ordinary arrows by one formal mesh edge from each nonprojective vertex to its translate. Homotopy cancels an arrow with its formal inverse and identifies a formal mesh edge with every polarized length-two route through that mesh.
